name: Sleepers' Key
summary: At Stonetalon Peak, Sleepers' Key helps guard a sacred druidic vault. Night elf druids made it one of three enchanted keys for the Talon Den Hoard.

sections.title: A Druidic Safeguard
sections.body: The Talon Den rises on Stonetalon Peak as a redoubt and sanctum for the druids of Kalimdor. To guard sacred relics and potent treasures from unwanted attention, night elf keepers built a system of locks and hidden caches. Sleepers' Key is one of three keys that together form a protective ward. The key lies in a secluded cache deep in the den, opened with the Gatekeeper's Key hidden near the threshold. The Claw Key and the Barrow Key complete the set. Set all three into the Talon Den Hoard's stone locks, and the ward fades, revealing the ancient items within.

faq.q: What is the Sleepers' Key used for?
faq.answer: Sleepers' Key opens the Talon Den Hoard with the Barrow Key and Claw Key. The warded stone vault lies deep within the barrow den at Stonetalon Peak.

faq.q: How was the Sleepers' Key locked away?
faq.answer: The druids placed Sleepers' Key in the Sleepers' Cache in the Talon Den's northwestern tunnels. The Gatekeeper's Key opens it; the druids hid that key in an unassuming lantern near the den's entrance.

faq.q: Why did the druids hide their relics with multiple keys?
faq.answer: The night elf druids built complex safeguards so their powerful items and sacred heirlooms would not fall into enemy hands if the den came under attack. By dispersing the keys among hidden caches, they made the hoard difficult for intruders to plunder.

faq.q: Why is it called the Sleepers' Key?
faq.answer: The druids never explain the name. Sleepers' Key shares it with the Sleepers' Cache, the hidden chest in the Talon Den where the key is kept.

angles.text: As a druid, you can see how the Talon Den keys and caches layer defenses, using hidden caches and keyed locks to seal away relics of power.

As a member of the Horde, acquiring Sleepers' Key is part of an orchestrated raid into the heart of Stonetalon Peak, stripping away the night elves' defensive wards to claim the relics sealed in their hoard.
